author: The Infographics Show
description:
Free ChatGPT is dying. OpenAI is burning billions, downgrading free users, hiding better AI behind a $200 paywall, and preparing to turn chats into ad space.

ChatGPT was never truly free. It was subsidized by massive investor money while OpenAI chased growth, users, and a future IPO. But now the costs of AI infrastructure, data centers, GPUs, and compute are catching up.

Free users are increasingly being pushed toward cheaper, weaker models, while the smartest tools move behind expensive tiers like ChatGPT Pro. At the same time, ads are entering the picture, safety researchers are leaving, and rivals like Anthropic’s Claude are closing the gap.

What began as a free AI assistant is turning into a paid intelligence system where the best version goes to whoever can afford it.
